run_convert_hf_to_fp8: run the script to compress a HuggingFace model to FP8 format using a model stub argument
run_oneshot_quantization: run the oneshot function to apply FP8 quantization to a loaded model with a recipe
run_calculate_offload_device_map: run calculate_offload_device_map to determine GPU offloading strategy for a model
run_sparse_auto_model_load: run SparseAutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained to load a model with FP16 dtype and device mapping
run_fp8_compression_recipe: run the FP8 compression recipe with channel-wise weights and dynamic token-wise activations
